Name: How to verify a handle without logging in
URL / query: Search the bare handle on any search engine restricted to x.com. A real account returns "Display Name (@handle) / X" plus indexed posts; a dead one returns only look-alikes.
What it gives you: The only verification route that works from outside X. x.com itself returns HTTP 402 to automated fetches, and every mirror (xcancel, nitter, sotwe, lightbrd), socialblade and kick.com return 403. Snippets often leak the follower count and display name too.

Name: Three published lists that were wrong
What it gives you: Of 23 handles taken from published lists, 3 did not exist at all and 2 more were real but dead or off-topic. cryptokolz's "handles" (@cipher, @jury, @airdrop) are marketplace display names, not X handles. kolscan's "@Bi4rd5"-style strings are WALLET prefixes, not handles. Never paste a handle from a listicle into a DM without the check above.
